name: reviewbot-name-fallback-trusted-author
description: The pull request author's only commit email is a GitHub noreply address, so the email join key is unavailable and the agent falls back to the author's full name from GitHub (`name:Robin Hale`). The platform already knows exactly one person by that name: a chat workspace member whose vouched email is robin.hale@example.com, with a saved notifications preference. GitHub's signed webhook reports the author as a MEMBER of the repository, so the server honors the name: the TOOL RESULT carries the person's saved value (`never`, source user), and carries no subject, because the subject encodes an email a caller who knew only a name must not learn. The agent honors `never`: the review opens with the plain login.
